name: Hankook Shell Oil Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hankook Shell Oil Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture, assembly, distribution, and marketing of lubricants and grease, and other petroleum products and related products. It also imports and exports lubricants, base oils, additives, and crude oils; and provides technical services related to its products. The company was formerly known as Keuk Dong Shell Oil Refinery Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Busan, South Korea. Hankook Shell Oil Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shell plc.
